Angl was built by a basketball coach, and basketball still shows through in
places it shouldn't. The data model is sport-agnostic; the rest is catching up.

You don't need to know where in the code the problem lives, or whether it is
"really" a bug. Describing what you said and what you expected is the useful
part — that is the thing we can't work out from here.

## What sport do you coach?

<!-- Netball, football, hockey, water polo, rugby, futsal, anything. Include
     the level if it matters — a U12 side and a senior league can want
     different things. -->

## What did you say or do?

<!-- The exact words, if it was dictation — "clip that, centre pass, held ball"
     — or the steps you took if it was clicking. Verbatim beats a summary here:
     the parser cares about the actual words, so a paraphrase can accidentally
     fix the bug. -->

## What did Angl do?

<!-- What you actually got. A wrong timestamp, a label that lost a word, a clip
     of the wrong length, a category you didn't want, basketball wording in the
     interface. A screenshot is welcome but not required. -->

## What did you expect instead?

<!-- What the right answer would have been. If a length was wrong, roughly how
     long the clip should have been. -->

- Did you have an LLM configured in Settings, or were you on the built-in parser?
